studies.title: The jet airliner
studies.caption: Jet airliners enter service across the Atlantic and the Pacific, flying above the weather at 900 kilometres an hour.
studies.prompt: Wide low airport-apron view of a1958 four-engine Boeing707-style swept-wing passenger jet, four slim engine nacelles below wings, mobile boarding stairs and a few period passengers. Bare metal and restrained colors without brand logos; no jumbo jet, jet bridge, or modern high-bypass engines.
